channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Patterson seeks Revenue Commissioner re-election
item.description: Incumbent Covington County Revenue Commissioner George “Chuck” Patterson, a 10-year officeholder, announces his Republican re-election bid, citing experience and focus on efficient, reliable service.

item.title: Straughn High School hires Humphrey as football coach
item.description: After stops at St. Luke’s, Murphy, Demopolis, Stanhope Elmore and Excel, last season’s Straughn OC Clint Humphrey is named SHS head coach, focused on high standards and player development.

item.title: HB61 goes to subcommittee in Montgomery
item.description: HB61, which would block underground storage for a Covington County carbon capture project, stalled in its first House hearing and was sent to a subcommittee for further review.

item.title: OCAC brings community together with art
item.description: Opp Cultural Arts Center showcases local talent with monthly exhibits, painting classes, pet portraits, visiting artists and plans for summer events like a Jazz Café and food trucks.

item.title: PLEASANT HOME-COMING
item.description: Pleasant Home School’s 100th homecoming features a Flying Freedom Eagle statue unveiling, parade, FFA String Band performance, community basketball game and the 2026 homecoming court.

item.title: Wednesday | January 28, 2026 E-edition
item.description: Explore the full digital version of our January 24, 2026 issue and stay updated with the latest news and features.

item.title: Randolph Thomason Obituary
item.description: Randolph Paul (Randy) Thomason Jr., 40, of Panama City, FL, a musician, artist and writer, died Jan. 19, 2026; services are Jan. 31 at Wilson Funeral Home Chapel.

item.title: Bobby Lester Blocker
item.description: Bobby Lester Blocker, 79, of Andalusia, Alabama, died Jan. 22, 2025; funeral is Jan. 26 at Foreman Funeral Home with burial in Oak Grove Cemetery, Dozier.

item.title: Debra Swords Obituary
item.description: Debra Ann Denney Swords, 63, of Andalusia, dies Jan. 21; services Jan. 28 at Keahey Funeral Home Chapel with burial at Stone Lake Gardens Cemetery.

item.title: Jail Report from January 22 to January 26
item.description: Covington County Jail report lists Jan. 22–26 bookings, detailing arrests on probation violations, drug charges, failures to appear, domestic violence and other offenses.
